_law: A schedule that nobody checks is a promise nobody keeps. This file is the promise; probe-ordnance is the checking. Neither is complete without the other.
_howToRead: mechanism  — the KV prefix / internal name the code and firing log use. PERMANENT. Never rename (see RULING-THE-DISPATCH-TWO-NAMES).
surface    — what a reader sees. The public name. May differ from mechanism, deliberately.
state      — live | paused | retired-at-surface. The probe reads THIS before crying WARN: a paused tube that is quiet is behaving; a live tube that is quiet is a fault.
cadence    — how often it is MEANT to fire. The probe measures lastAgeDays against this.

cron       — the schedule string the trigger SHOULD carry, for the probe's armed/not-armed check. The trigger itself lives in the private Amenti-Workers; this is the expected value, not the source of truth for the trigger.
prefixes   — the KV key prefixes this tube's output is stored under, so the probe knows where to look.
_note: This declares INTENT. It does not fire anything and it does not store content. The triggers live in Amenti-Workers (private); the content lives in KV. This is the third layer — what the captain decided — made readable so a session reads it instead of asking.
